name: Europe hybrid attacks
summary: Hoax bomb threats hit at least 18 European flights; Poland detains six suspected of supplying Russia
state: At least 18 European passenger flights faced bomb threats in the latest wave, nine Prague-bound planes were investigated and Ireland's RTE was evacuated over a bomb threat, Anadolu reported on 6 Nov; no explosives were found and no state has been formally blamed. Polish security services detained six people suspected of supplying military components to Russia for its intelligence services.
for_you: Expect occasional flight diversions and security checks. Follow airline and airport notices, and report suspicious items to police.
rubric_hit: Repeated hoax disruption and espionage arrests, no airport closure or state attribution = Watch
why: Sabotage, arson and drone incursions over airports and bases are how state confrontation reaches daily life in the UK and Europe.
drivers: Russia–NATO tensions, drone and cyber capabilities, proxy recruitment, elections.

rubric.alert: Repeated airport or infrastructure shutdowns across several countries, or sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
rubric.watch: Drone incursions close an airport or military base, or a sabotage incident is attributed to a state.
rubric.normal: No significant attributed sabotage or airspace incursions in Europe this week.
